title: data/publish/.../points_distribution.json
description: Refused outright, not merely optional. Measured on season 2026 the four basketball cells qualify 8 of 12, 8 of 12, 10 of 10 and 4 of 11 teams for the post-season -- four cells, four structures, one of which takes every team through -- and the league table decides the deildarmeistari while the Islandsmeistari comes out of an urslitakeppni this model does not simulate. A p_top_six or p_winner here would be a top-six number wearing a playoff label (design D3), so the contract rejects it rather than tolerating it. p_relegation is OPTIONAL rather than required: `relegation_slots` is unconfigured on all eight basketball and handball cells (no KKI or HSI regulation was resolved), and for a bottom-tier division -- basketball 1. deild, handball Grill 66 -- nothing is relegated at all, so football's hardcoded bottom-two rule would publish a Fallhaetta headline that is false rather than merely uncertain. The producer emits the key exactly where the division configures the number, mirroring p_qualify (ID-B15); configuring relegation_slots is what turns it on.

p_top_of_table.description: Probability of finishing first in the table this cell publishes; see meta.season_scope for what that table is. There is deliberately no top-level `basis` here -- read it from meta.season_scope.
